page.metaTitle: Costco Price Tracker & Stock Alerts | WebMonitor.fyi
page.metaDescription: Track Costco prices, member-only deals, and product availability with automated alerts. Catch limited-time member offers without checking manually.
page.h1: Costco price tracker with stock alerts
page.subtitle: Monitor Costco.com prices, member-only deals, and product availability. Alerts arrive when something changes.
page.intro: WebMonitor.fyi tracks Costco product pages for price drops, member-only deal activations, and stock changes. Costco rotates limited-time offers on a monthly cadence with sharp markdowns — the Costco price tracker catches them within the next check cycle so you don't miss a member-only deal window.

features.title: Limited-time deal detection
features.body: Costco's monthly Hot Buys, Black Friday-style October savings, and member promotions appear and disappear quickly. Catch them early in the deal window.

features.title: Stock and shipping availability
features.body: Watch for restocks on high-demand items and changes to ship-to-home availability.

features.title: Bulk-purchase planning
features.body: Useful for restocking pantry staples, household goods, and seasonal items at the lowest price point of the quarter.

features.title: Cross-retailer comparison
features.body: Run parallel monitors to compare Costco pricing on a SKU with Sam's Club, Amazon, and Walmart.

steps.title: Paste the Costco product URL
steps.body: Add New Monitor → paste the product link.

steps.title: Set the criterion
steps.body: Examples: "Alert me when this drops below $X." "Notify me when a member-only deal is applied to this item." "Let me know when this is back in stock."

steps.title: Pick a frequency
steps.body: Daily checks work for steady tracking; hourly or 30-minute (Pro) for tracking a specific limited-time deal cycle.

useCases: Catch Costco Hot Buys and monthly member savings
Track bulk-purchase staples for the lowest annual price
Watch for restocks on seasonal items (patio furniture, holiday goods)
Compare Costco pricing to Sam's Club and Walmart with parallel monitors
Monitor electronics and appliance deals during major sale events
page.limits: Costco shows different pricing for members vs. non-members on some pages. WebMonitor reads the publicly rendered page — if a price requires logged-in membership to display, that page is outside scope. Most Costco.com pricing renders publicly.

faq.a: When member-only pricing renders on the public product page (it often does, with a member-price tag), yes. When the price is hidden behind a login wall, no.

faq.q: Does Costco update prices frequently enough to need a 30-minute check?
faq.a: Usually no — daily or hourly checks are fine for most Costco monitoring. 30-minute checks make sense during October Savings and other concentrated promotional windows.

faq.q: Can I monitor warehouse stock at my local Costco?
faq.a: No. Warehouse stock is not exposed on Costco.com. WebMonitor only sees what Costco.com renders publicly.

faq.q: Does this work for Costco Travel or other Costco services?
faq.a: Yes — any publicly accessible Costco page works, including Costco Travel listings.
